summary.tldr: Requires registered charities to report counts of their officials in designated groups and creates a yearly public summary report.
what_it_does: Requires registered charities to say, in their annual information return, how many directors, trustees, officers or similar officials belong to each designated group under the Employment Equity Act.
Allows the Minister of National Revenue to use that information only to prepare the annual report or for deregistration procedures.
Requires the minister to prepare an annual report by June 1 showing totals for registered charities and their officials in each designated group, using aggregate data only.
Prohibits the report from naming any charity or any individual official, but allows extra information or analysis.
Requires the report to be tabled in both Houses of Parliament within 10 sitting days and posted online as soon as practical after tabling.
Allows a charity’s registration to be revoked if it does not provide the required information.
summary.background: The bill amends the Income Tax Act. It uses the Employment Equity Act definition of “designated groups.”
